contract.baseProfile: Composer lock must contain workerman/webman-framework and the project must contain composer.json, composer.lock, start.php, and app
contract.saiAdminProfile: Composer lock must additionally contain saithink/saiadmin and both installed and Composer package source structures must match the required SaiAdmin skeleton
contract.versionPolicy: profile detection records locked versions but does not impose a Webman or SaiAdmin version whitelist
contract.explicitProfile: an explicit profile that differs from the detected profile fails closed
contract.incompleteEvidence: either SaiAdmin directory markers without a lock package or a lock package without the required installed/package structures fails closed

cases: saithink/saiadmin lock package without SaiAdmin structures

realSaiAdminReadOnly.privacy: only package versions and generic structure names were recorded
